meta.name: competitive-analysis-process
meta.description: Orchestrate a complete competitive analysis across six steps, from landscape to strategic direction. Use when you need the full picture, not a single scan or card.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完整走一遍竞争分析,从市场格局到战略方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全局看清竞争态势并推导战略方向
copy.tagline_en: Run a complete competitive analysis, from market landscape to strategic direction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a full competitive picture to guide strategic decisions

howto.what: Claude 会按六步流程引导你跑完一次竞争分析：先确认范围和决策，再分析市场格局、产品对比、客户需求、商业基线、认知定位与对手未来方向，最后生成作战卡片、对比矩阵、定位反击和威胁评估等产出。
howto.when: 当你需要完整的竞争分析全景而非单次扫描或单张卡片时触发，如为新战略周期全面分析市场、整理零散情报、按决策选步骤跑流程等。

say.text: 对中端薪资市场跑完整竞争分析，决策是守下沉还是向上打。
say.note: 它会先确认范围，再推荐步骤顺序。

say.text: 我有一堆零散竞品资料，用这套流程整理成可执行产出。
say.note: 它将把已有资料当作输入，按步骤补缺。

say.text: 我们被一家对手抢企业单，帮我挑最关键的几步跑。
say.note: Claude 会按决策推荐步骤子集，跳过无关环节。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a six-step competitive analysis from scoping to strategic direction, delegating each step to a specialist skill, and ends with actionable artifacts like battle cards and comparison matrices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need the full competitive picture, not one scan or card; e.g., planning a new strategy cycle, organizing scattered research, or picking steps for a decision.

say_en.text: Run full competitive analysis on mid-market payroll; defend down or push up.
say_en.note: Claude confirms scope and recommends which steps to run.

say_en.text: Scattered intel here; run this process to produce battle cards and matrices.
say_en.note: Existing intel is treated as input; steps fill gaps.

say_en.text: We keep losing enterprise deals to one rival; scope the analysis to that fight.
say_en.note: Claude recommends a step subset based on the decision.
